ruling.recommended_action: Decline the waiver request: cancellation was made by the rider 3 min 05 s after matching, so the $6.61 cancellation fee stands (NS-4). Inform the rider of the 30-day voucher-based waiver channel under NS-7.

rejected_claims.reason: NS-4: an instant booking cancelled more than 3 minutes after matching is chargeable ($6.61); the driver's distance/ETA does not create a free-cancellation right. NS-8 (driver-late-vs-ETA waiver) is non-citable and Ryde has no such published rule.

NS-2 applies only where the driver cancelled alleging rider no-show; here cancelled_by = rider (driver_arrived_at and driver_pressed_here_at are null, driver_statement says he was en route), so NS-1/NS-2 are not triggered.
